subject: physics
question_text: Hydrogen is abundant around the sun but not around the earth. Explain.

verification.note: The mark split is invented and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. The question itself is sourced, not invented. AI physics check 2026-08-24: formulas, signs, numbers and claims verified against NCERT Class-11 conventions; corrections applied to explanation text (why / common_mistakes / memory_tip), marked answer lines unchanged unless factually wrong.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Around the sun
lines: The sun has a very large mass, so its escape
velocity is much GREATER than the r.m.s.
speed of hydrogen molecules. The molecules
cannot get away, so hydrogen stays.
steps.why: The comparison is always the same one: escape velocity against the typical molecular speed.
common_mistakes: Explaining it by temperature alone, without comparing the two speeds.

recall.must_convey: That the sun has a very large escape velocity, greater than the r m s speed of hydrogen, so hydrogen cannot escape.
accept: escape velocity greater than the r m s speed
hydrogen cannot escape from the sun

steps.memory_tip: One comparison decides it: escape velocity against the typical molecular speed. The sun has an enormous v_e, so hydrogen stays.

steps.label: Around the earth
lines: The earth’s escape velocity is SMALLER than
the r.m.s. speed of hydrogen molecules, so
they escape into space over time.

lines.text: Escape velocity vs r.m.s. speed decides it

lines: Heavier gases move more slowly and stay.
steps.why: The same rule explains why the earth keeps nitrogen and oxygen: a heavier molecule at the same temperature moves more slowly. In truth hydrogen’s r.m.s. speed near the earth (about 2 km s⁻¹) is below 11.2 km s⁻¹; escape happens because the fastest molecules in the distribution exceed v_e over long times. The marked line is the book’s simplified comparison.
common_mistakes: Saying the earth has no hydrogen at all; it has very little free hydrogen, not none.

recall.must_convey: That the earth escape velocity is smaller than the r m s speed of hydrogen, so hydrogen escapes.
reject: hydrogen cannot escape from the sun

steps.memory_tip: On earth, light and fast hydrogen moves faster than our smaller v_e and escapes; heavier gases stay.
